ApplyScalingGroup.description_en: Creates and manages ECI-based scaling groups by using a configuration file. You can call the ApplyScalingGroup operation to implement this feature
ApplyScalingGroup.description_zh: 如果您需要通过配置文件方式快速创建和管理ECI类型的伸缩组，则可以通过调用API ApplyScalingGroup来实现该功能

AttachAlbServerGroups.description_en: Adds one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups to a scaling group
AttachAlbServerGroups.description_zh: 向伸缩组添加一个或多个ALB服务器组

AttachDBInstances.description_en: Adds one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances

AttachInstances.description_en: Manually adds ECS instances to a scaling group
AttachInstances.description_zh: 为伸缩组手动添加ECS实例

AttachLoadBalancers.description_en: Adds one or more load balancing instances
AttachLoadBalancers.description_zh: 添加一个或多个负载均衡实例

AttachServerGroups.description_en: Adds one or more load balancing server groups to a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB)
AttachServerGroups.description_zh: 从伸缩组添加一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括：应用型负载均衡ALB (Application Load Balancer)、网络型负载均衡NLB (Network Load Balancer)

AttachVServerGroups.description_en: Adds one or more virtual service groups under a load balancing instance
AttachVServerGroups.description_zh: 添加负载均衡实例下的一个或者多个虚拟服务器组。

CancelInstanceRefresh.description_en: Cancels an instance refresh task. Instances that have already been replaced or added during scale-out are retained
CancelInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 取消实例刷新任务，会保留已经完成替换和扩容的新实例

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Adds a scaling group as a resource to a resource group
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 将一个伸缩组作为资源加入一个资源组

CompleteLifecycleAction.description_en: Completes the wait state of a scaling activity ahead of schedule
CompleteLifecycleAction.description_zh: 提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态

CreateEciScalingConfiguration.description_en: Creates a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) type
CreateEciScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 创建一个ECI类型的伸缩配置

CreateLifecycleHook.description_en: Creates one or more lifecycle hooks for a scaling group
CreateLifecycleHook.description_zh: 为伸缩组创建一个或多个生命周期挂钩

CreateNotificationConfiguration.description_en: Creates auto scaling event and resource change notifications
CreateNotificationConfiguration.description_zh: 创建弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知。

CreateScalingConfiguration.description_en: Creates an ECS-type scaling configuration for a scaling group by calling the CreateScalingConfiguration operation with the scaling group ID, instance type, instance image, and other information specified
CreateScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 通过调用CreateScalingConfiguration接口，并指定伸缩组ID、实例规格、实例镜像等信息，为伸缩组创建一个ECS类型的伸缩配置

CreateScalingGroup.description_en: Creates a scaling group to automatically adjust your compute capacity (the number of instances) based on business changes and policies
CreateScalingGroup.description_zh: 如果您需要根据业务变动需求与策略自动增加或减少指定类型的实例数量，则可以通过调用API CreateScalingGroup创建伸缩组来自动调整您的业务计算能力（即实例数量）

DeactivateScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 使指定伸缩配置进入失效状态

DeleteEciScalingConfiguration.description_en: Deletes a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) type
DeleteEciScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 删除一个ECI类型的伸缩配置

DeleteLifecycleHook.description_zh: 删除一个生命周期挂钩。

DeleteNotificationConfiguration.description_en: Deletes an auto scaling event and resource change notification
DeleteNotificationConfiguration.description_zh: 删除一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知

DescribeAlertConfiguration.description_en: When a scaling activity succeeds, fails, or is rejected, Auto Scaling can send notifications through SMS or email. You must handle the related events after receiving the notifications. You can call the DescribeAlertConfiguration operation to query the scaling activity statuses for which SMS and email notifications are sent in a scaling group. This helps you stay informed about changes to scaling activities and respond quickly to improve scaling efficiency
DescribeAlertConfiguration.description_zh: 伸缩活动在执行成功、失败或者被拒绝时，弹性伸缩支持通过短信、邮件方式发送消息通知，您需要在接收到消息后自行处理相关事件。您可以调用API DescribeAlertConfiguration查询伸缩组中的发送短信、邮件通知的伸缩活动状态，方便您及时了解某个伸缩活动的变化，快速响应提高扩缩容效率

DescribeEciScalingConfigurations.description_en: Queries scaling configurations of the ECI type
DescribeEciScalingConfigurations.description_zh: 查询ECI类型的伸缩配置信息

DescribeElasticStrength.description_en: The validity of a scaling group configuration largely determines the success rate of scale-out operations. Auto Scaling uses elastic strength to describe the validity of scaling configurations, quantifying configuration quality and helping you optimize scaling configurations accordingly
DescribeElasticStrength.description_zh: 伸缩组配置的有效性很大程度决定了扩容过程的成功率。弹性伸缩通过弹性强度描述伸缩配置的有效性，让配置的优良程度量化，帮助用户针对性的优化伸缩配置

DescribeInstanceRefreshes.description_en: Queries instance refresh tasks for a scaling group, including basic information and progress of each task
DescribeInstanceRefreshes.description_zh: 如果您需要查看实例刷新任务的基本信息、 实例刷新任务的进度等信息，您可以调用DescribeInstanceRefreshes查询该伸缩组的实例刷新任务

DescribeLifecycleActions.description_en: Queries lifecycle tokens by scaling activity ID and status
DescribeLifecycleActions.description_zh: 根据伸缩活动ID和状态查询 Lifecycle Token

DescribeNotificationConfigurations.description_en: Queries the auto scaling events and resource change notifications that you created
DescribeNotificationConfigurations.description_zh: 查询您创建的弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知。

DescribeNotificationTypes.description_en: Queries the types of Auto Scaling events and resource change notifications
DescribeNotificationTypes.description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知的类型。

DescribePatternTypes.description_en: When configuring scaling configurations using the instance attribute-based method, call the DescribePatternTypes API to filter eligible instance types based on specified instance attributes such as the number of vCPU cores, memory size, instance family level, and the maximum acceptable price
DescribePatternTypes.description_zh: 使用指定实例属性方式配置伸缩配置时，调用API DescribePatternTypes接口根据指定实例的vCPU核数、内存大小、规格族级别以及可接受的最高价格等属性，筛选出符合要求的实例规格

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where Auto Scaling is available
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询可以使用弹性伸缩服务的地域

DescribeScalingActivityDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a scaling activity
DescribeScalingActivityDetail.description_zh: 查询一个伸缩活动的详细信息

DescribeScalingConfigurations.description_en: Queries information about ECS-type scaling configurations, including instance types and images, so that you can learn about the ECS instance templates used for scale-out activities in advance
DescribeScalingConfigurations.description_zh: 调用API DescribeScalingConfigurations查询ECS类型伸缩配置的信息，包括实例规格、镜像等信息，方便您提前了解弹性扩张时使用的ECS实例模板详情

DescribeScalingInstances.description_en: Queries the list of ECS instances in a scaling group and their information by scaling group ID, including the total number of running spot instances, total number of ECS instances, warmup state of ECS instances, and lifecycle state. You can also filter ECS instances by health check status, lifecycle state, or creation type
DescribeScalingInstances.description_zh: 调用DescribeScalingInstances，通过伸缩组ID查询该伸缩组内的ECS实例列表及实例信息，包括当前伸缩组中，运行状态的抢占式实例总数、ECS实例总数、ECS实例的预热状态、生命周期状态等。同时也支持指定实例健康状态、生命周期状态、创建方式等筛选符合要求的ECS实例

DescribeScalingRules.description_en: Queries the scaling rules in a scaling group and returns information about the scaling rules
DescribeScalingRules.description_zh: 查询伸缩组下的伸缩规则，并列出伸缩规则的信息

DetachAlbServerGroups.description_en: Removes one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups from a scaling group
DetachAlbServerGroups.description_zh: 从伸缩组移出一个或多个ALB服务器组

DetachDBInstances.description_en: Removes one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances

DetachInstances.description_en: Removes one or more ECS instances from a scaling group
DetachInstances.description_zh: 从一个伸缩组移出一台或多台ECS实例

DetachLoadBalancers.description_en: Removes one or more load balancing instances
DetachLoadBalancers.description_zh: 移除一个或多个负载均衡实例

DetachServerGroups.description_en: Removes one or more load balancing server groups from a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB)
DetachServerGroups.description_zh: 从伸缩组移除一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）和网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）

DetachVServerGroups.description_en: Removes one or more virtual server groups
DetachVServerGroups.description_zh: 移除一个或者多个虚拟服务器组

EnterStandby.description_en: Sets ECS instances in a scaling group to the standby state
EnterStandby.description_zh: 将伸缩组内的ECS实例设置为备用状态

ExitStandby.description_en: Transitions ECS instances in standby state within a scaling group to the running state
ExitStandby.description_zh: 使伸缩组内处于备用状态的ECS实例进入运行状态

ListTagKeys.description_en: Queries the list of tag keys for Auto Scaling resources
ListTagKeys.description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩资源标签键的列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the labels that are attached to one or more elastic scaling resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性伸缩资源已经绑定的标签列表

ListTagValues.description_en: Queries the tag values that correspond to a tag key of Auto Scaling resources
ListTagValues.description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩资源标签键对应的标签值

ModifyAlertConfiguration.description_en: When a scaling activity succeeds, fails, or is rejected, Auto Scaling can send notifications through SMS or email. You must handle the related events after receiving the notifications. You can call the ModifyAlertConfiguration operation to set the scaling activity statuses for which SMS and email notifications are sent in a scaling group. This helps you stay informed about scaling activity changes and respond promptly to improve scaling efficiency
ModifyAlertConfiguration.description_zh: 伸缩活动在执行成功、失败或者被拒绝时，弹性伸缩支持通过短信、邮件方式发送消息通知，您需要在接收到消息后自行处理相关事件。您可以调用API ModifyAlertConfiguration设置伸缩组中需要发送短信、邮件通知的伸缩活动状态，方便您及时了解某个伸缩活动的变化，快速响应提高扩缩容效率

ModifyEciScalingConfiguration.description_en: Modifies a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) type
ModifyEciScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 调用ModifyScalingConfiguration修改一个ECI类型的伸缩配置

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies partial information of an ECS instance in a scaling group by calling the ModifyInstanceAttribute API. Currently, only the lifecycle management property of instances manually added to a scaling group can be modified, allowing Auto Scaling to manage ECS instances in the scaling group more flexibly
ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 调用API ModifyInstanceAttribute修改伸缩组中一台ECS实例的部分信息，目前仅支持修改手动添加到伸缩组中的实例的生命周期托管属性，方便弹性伸缩更加灵活地管理伸缩组中的ECS实例

ModifyLifecycleHook.description_en: Modifies the information of a lifecycle hook
ModifyLifecycleHook.description_zh: 修改一个生命周期挂钩的信息。

ModifyNotificationConfiguration.description_en: Modifies a notification for Auto Scaling events and resource changes
ModifyNotificationConfiguration.description_zh: 修改一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知

ModifyScalingConfiguration.description_en: Modifies an ECS-type scaling configuration (the ECS instance template used for scale-out) by calling the ModifyScalingConfiguration API if the current scaling configuration does not meet your business requirements
ModifyScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 如果当前的伸缩配置不满足业务需求，您可以通过调用API ModifyScalingConfiguration修改ECS类型的伸缩配置（即待扩容的ECS实例模板）

ModifyScheduledTask.description_en: Modifies the information of a scheduled task
ModifyScheduledTask.description_zh: 修改一个定时任务的信息

RebalanceInstances.description_en: Rebalances the distribution of ECS instances across zones in a multi-zone scaling group
RebalanceInstances.description_zh: 重新平衡多可用区伸缩组内ECS实例的分布

RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat.description_en: Extends the wait time for an ECS instance that is suspended after a lifecycle hook is triggered
RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat.description_zh: 延长一个生命周期挂钩触发后被挂起的ECS实例的等待时间

RemoveInstances.description_en: Removes one or more ECS instances from a scaling group
RemoveInstances.description_zh: 从一个伸缩组删除一台或多台ECS实例

ResumeInstanceRefresh.description_en: Resumes an instance refresh task that is in the paused state
ResumeInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 恢复一个处于暂停状态的实例刷新任务

ResumeProcesses.description_en: Resumes paused scaling processes in a scaling group
ResumeProcesses.description_zh: 恢复伸缩组中被暂停的流程

RollbackInstanceRefresh.description_en: Rolls back an instance refresh task during execution. If the desired configuration no longer meets your requirements during an instance refresh task, you can call this operation to roll back the task. During the rollback, the system creates new instances based on the currently active configuration of the scaling group to replace instances that were created based on the desired configuration
RollbackInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 在实例刷新任务执行过程中，如果发现期望配置不符合需求，您可以调用此API来回滚实例刷新任务。在回滚时，系统将使用伸缩组当前生效的配置来创建新的实例，以替换那些基于期望配置创建的实例

ScaleWithAdjustment.description_en: Triggers elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule
ScaleWithAdjustment.description_zh: 基于指定调整规则触发弹性扩缩容

SetGroupDeletionProtection.description_en: Enables or disables deletion protection for a scaling group
SetGroupDeletionProtection.description_zh: 为伸缩组开启或关闭删除保护

SetInstanceHealth.description_en: Sets the health status of an ECS instance in a scaling group
SetInstanceHealth.description_zh: 设置伸缩组内ECS实例的健康状态

SetInstancesProtection.description_en: Starts or stops protection for one or more ECS instances in a scaling group
SetInstancesProtection.description_zh: 开始保护或者停止保护伸缩组内的一台或者多台ECS实例

StartInstanceRefresh.description_en: Starts an instance refresh task in a scaling group to apply a new scaling configuration or update the image of instances in the scaling group
StartInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 在您需要将新的伸缩配置应用到伸缩组实例中时，或需要更新伸缩组中实例的镜像时，您可以调用本接口完成伸缩组中实例的刷新

SuspendInstanceRefresh.description_en: Pauses an instance refresh task during execution. If you suspect that the configuration has issues but are not sure whether a rollback is needed, you can call this operation to pause the instance refresh task and check whether the configuration is correct
SuspendInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 实例刷新任务执行期间，如果您觉得配置存在问题，但不确定是否需要回滚，您可以调用此API暂停实例刷新任务，在此期间，您可以检查配置是否正确

SuspendProcesses.description_en: Suspends specified scaling processes in a scaling group
SuspendProcesses.description_zh: 暂停伸缩组中的指定流程

TagResources.description_en: Creates and binds tags to a specified list of Auto Scaling resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的弹性伸缩资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: After a tag is unbound, the tag is automatically deleted if it is not bound to any other resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 解绑后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何资源，会被自动删除

VerifyAuthentication.description_en: Checks whether Auto Scaling is authorized to operate on ECS resources
VerifyAuthentication.description_zh: 检测是否已授权弹性伸缩调操作ECS资源

VerifyUser.description_en: Verifies whether Auto Scaling is activated
VerifyUser.description_zh: 验证是否已开通弹性伸缩服务
